channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block D2
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block D2 (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D2: The Design Controls permit only structured parking on Block D2…
item.description: The Design Controls permit only structured parking on Block D2 but require the structure to provide at least 10,000 square feet of active uses and/or transit-related services at the ground floor. The 97,498 sq ft area is the March 2012 proposal's figure for Block D as a whole, before the 2018 Design Controls divided it into D1 and D2. The Port's June 2026 report schedules the Developer's Phase 2 Submittal for Winter/Spring 2027 and a possible construction start for Summer/Fall 2027 (expected dates); no source read reports construction or a vertical design submittal for this block or states its current use. The Port's October 2023 memo says Phase 2 will include the parking garage but does not name Parcel D2. The Board of Supervisors' own records date the Mission Rock DDA approval (Resolution 42-18) to February 13, 2018 and the final passage of the Development Agreement ordinance (No. 33-18) to February 27, 2018; the Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the City's approval date and lists the Board's EIR action (File 171286) among its final actions. The Port's fact sheet lists August 15, 2018 as the Development Agreement's effective date, and the Planning page dates the DDA 8/15/2018. The Port's January 2018 staff report describes the DDA's outside dates for starting later phases (a legal deadline, not a forecast); the DDA text itself has not been read, so no calendar date is given. DDA-specific section numbers and target dates previously listed here are removed because the DDA text has not been read. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf https://www.potreroview.net/mission-rock-development-continues-to-roll/ https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/r0042-18.pdf https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0033-18.pdf https://sfplanning.s3.amazonaws.com/sfmea/2013.0208ENV-Seawall%20Lot%20337_NOD.pdf https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2021-07/Mission%20Rock%20Fact%20Sheet_24June2021.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D2: Block D2's record and map shape now say: the April 2017 Draft…
item.description: Block D2's record and map shape now say: the April 2017 Draft EIR puts about 2,300 spaces in the Block D2 garage (with 700 more under Mission Rock Square), so the earlier 'not confirmed as D2 alone' was removed; the 1,000 to 1,500 car and 750 to 1,000 space interim parking figures are a 2019 forecast, not a present count; the land-use plan cited is the Design Controls', not the 2012 proposal; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the Port Commission actions of 2018, 2023, 2025 and 2026 cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged. Source: SF Planning, Seawall Lot 337 and Pier 48 Mixed-Use Project Draft EIR, Chapter 2, 2017-04 (https://sfplanning.s3.amazonaws.com/sfmea/MissionRock_Ch_2_ProjectDescription.pdf); Mission Rock Partners, Mission Rock Phase 1 Overview, 2019-07-02 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2011D%20Attachment%201%20Mission%20Rock%20Draft%20Phase%201%20Submittal%20Summary_06%2027%2019_2.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download), 2023-10-10 (https://www.sfport.com/media/9218/download?inline), 2025-03-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10376/download?inline), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11337/download?inline).

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D2: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03…
item.description: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sep 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range. item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D2: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34… (Jun 9, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34, authorizing up to $10 million in Port Capital as pre-development funding for Phase 2 (design/engineering for Phase 2 infrastructure and vertical buildings), intended to avoid a 12-18 month delay to construction readiness. Staff's schedule contemplates horizontal infrastructure and vertical building construction beginning as early as Summer/Fall 2027, but the memo's own Table 1 gives illustrative repayment scenarios for a 2027, 2028 or 2029 vertical construction start, contingent on the Developer securing anchor tenants – not a committed date for this or any other Phase 2 block. (Jun 9, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D2: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher… (Mar 11, 2025)
item.description: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025). item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block D2: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed… (Oct 10, 2023)
item.description: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D2: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018… (Mar 6, 2018)
item.description: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the date the City 'decided to carry out or approve the project' and lists the Board of Supervisors' final actions, including File No. 171286 (affirming the Planning Department's certification of the Final EIR) and File No. 180092 (the DDA); it was filed March 9, 2018. The Board's own records date two of the other approvals earlier: Resolution 42-18 (the DDA, File 180092) was adopted February 13, 2018, and Ordinance 33-18 (the Development Agreement, File 171313) was finally passed February 27, 2018. The Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance; the Board's file shows an ordinance (Mar 6, 2018). Source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-13; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-27.
item.source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-13; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-27
